data.description_en:
Product type: Ready-to-eat refrigerated food ❄️
Net weight: 560g ⚖️
Origin: Guangzhou, China 🌍

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION 🧾

This is soup with weight.

Savory and brothy, built around creamy white beans, kale, and slow-simmered vegetables.

Comfort-forward, steady, and quietly satisfying.

WHY PEOPLE CHOOSE IT 🌾

It eats like a proper meal, not just a starter.

Beans bring body, vegetables keep it grounded, herbs lift everything at the end.

Cozy without dragging you down.

INGREDIENTS – SOUP 🌱

White beans, kale, potato, carrot, onion, garlic, shiitake mushroom powder, spices, chili flakes

CONTAINS / MAY CONTAIN ⚠️

Contains: None declared
May contain traces of: Soy, Gluten, Nuts

HOW TO EAT 🍽️

Heat the soup until hot.

Pairs well with grains or bread if you want to make it a full meal.

STORAGE & SHELF LIFE ❄️

Storage: Keep refrigerated at 0–4°C at all times
Shelf life: See packaging

FREEZING & DELIVERY NOTE ❄️

This product can be frozen for extended storage if you plan to enjoy it later.
When frozen, it can be kept for up to 2 months.
During delivery, the soup may arrive frozen or partially frozen due to temperature control.
If so, allow it to defrost naturally in the refrigerator, then heat thoroughly before eating.

NUTRITION (PER SERVING) 🧮

Energy 159kcal
Fat 2.9g
Carbohydrate 29.5g
Protein 6g

INTENDED USE / NOTES 📌

Plant-based product 🌿
Comfort-style vegetable soup
data.description_cn:
产品类型：即食冷藏食品 ❄️
净含量：560g ⚖️
产地：中国广州 🌍

产品描述 🧾

这是一碗有分量的汤。

以白芸豆、羽衣甘蓝和慢炖蔬菜为核心，汤体清爽但不单薄。

走的是舒适路线，稳扎稳打，安静地让人满足。

为什么人们会选它 🌾

它能当一顿正餐，而不只是开胃汤。

豆类提供厚度，蔬菜让整体站得住。

温暖、踏实，不拖重。

配料表 – 汤体 🌱

白芸豆、羽衣甘蓝、土豆、胡萝卜、洋葱、大蒜、香菇粉、香料、辣椒碎

致敏原信息 ⚠️

含有：未声明常见致敏原
可能含有微量：大豆、麸质、坚果

食用方式 🍽️

加热至完全热透后食用。

可搭配谷物或面包，作为完整一餐。

贮存与保质期 ❄️

贮存条件：全程 0–4°C 冷藏保存
保质期：见包装标示

冷冻与配送说明 ❄️

如需延后食用，本产品可进行冷冻保存。
冷冻状态下可保存最长 2 个月。
冷链配送过程中，产品可能会出现完全或部分冷冻的情况，属正常现象。
如遇此情况，请在冰箱冷藏室自然解冻，并充分加热后食用。

营养信息（每份）🧮

能量 159kcal
脂肪 2.9g
碳水化合物 29.5g
蛋白质 6g

食用提示 📌

植物性食品 🌿
舒适型蔬菜汤
